cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Long-Form Content Writer (AEO/SEO) position listed by Jobgether on behalf of your partner company. Your search for an AI-native content specialist who pairs advanced AI workflows with strong editorial judgment describes the way I already work: I use LLMs daily for research, drafting and audits, and I build websites that perform in both traditional search and AI-powered answer platforms.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console. I publish and update content in WordPress, keeping existing pages current and structured for search. Freelance, I designed and built mirook.com for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file. Iterative technical SEO/GEO audits measurably raised the site's search-health score. I also built baverok.com myself, including a hand-coded landing page with structured data and accessible markup.

What I bring to this role is a technical foundation combined with hands-on content experience. I'm comfortable designing and operating AI workflows rather than just using basic writing assistants, and I verify sources and reject AI output that doesn't meet quality standards. I understand answer-first structures, FAQ sections, schema-ready formatting and internal linking, and I use search performance data to prioritize refreshes. I'm proactive, autonomous and data-driven, and I continuously experiment with AI tools to improve efficiency without compromising editorial quality.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my mix of SEO, GEO/AEO and AI automation can support your scalable content operations.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
